answerFirstFaq.question: How is a settlement agreement taxed under UK employment law?
answerFirstFaq.answer: Under Section 403 of ITEPA 2003, genuine compensation payments up to £30,000 are completely tax-free. Any contractual earnings, accrued holiday pay, or payment in lieu of notice (PILON under PENP rules) remain subject to normal income tax and National Insurance. Your employer covers the cost of your independent legal review.
